The series has high trend and strong seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models.
Test a different weighting scheme (softmax_neg_error) to see if a smoother weighting improves robustness given unstable rankings.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a per‑horizon weighted mean may capture different best models across horizons.
The series has high trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust median over all models may reduce influence of outliers.
try a DBA combination on the full pool to see if a robust iterative approach beats trimmed_mean (trend_strength high, unstable ranking).
Use a per‑horizon weighted combo on the smaller, more stable pool4 to see if a different weight scheme improves over the DBA baseline.
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality; a simple mean over a correlated‑group subset (pool4) may outperform full‑pool weighted schemes.
Test a robust DBA on the smaller, stable pool4 to see if iterative trimming improves over full pool DBA (trend & seasonality high, ranking unstable).
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust softmax weighting on the stable 7‑model pool may improve over simple mean.
The ranking is unstable and several models cluster; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture changing dominance across horizons.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w7' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9238. Series context: trend strength 0.982 and seasonal strength 0.654; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.018); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.444.
